answer: A counterparty diversity threshold blocks a sybil tide: a new agent must trade with at least 20 distinct peers, and no partner may supply over 10 percent of its score. An attacker with 1000 fake identities must arrange 20000 verified trades at 0.2 POA each, paying 4000 POA, while an honest agent pays only 4 POA for 20 trades. Honest trust grows like velvet from real work, not from an echo chamber of copies, since self-dealing earns no score.
